It's located in the basement of Building B. This was my first time using their services (for a tooth extraction). I read reviews saying you have to book early because they only accept 8 patients per day, so I followed the reviews. When I arrived, it was true there were only 8 patients, as the remaining slots were for existing patients with many appointments. I queued at 6:25 AM and was number 6. I waited until 7:00 AM. A staff member opened the door, had my blood pressure checked, and I presented my card at the counter. Then, they gave me an estimated appointment time; mine was around 10:15 AM. I could go anywhere and come back later, but I had to stay within 15 minutes of my name being called, otherwise my turn would be skipped – this is common. The dentist was very gentle and explained everything well. Some staff members were a bit loud, but nothing serious; they just seemed to repeat questions to some patients. Overall, for my first visit, it was a great experience.
